_doc: Visitor types (the Visitor Guide). Reputation unlocks new kinds of visitor
in every museum; `weight` is how often each unlocked type walks in. `acc`
override the random outfit by material role. VIPs carry a tip bubble when a
tip is ready: tapping it pays `tip_seconds` of current income. One tip at a
time, then `vip_cooldown_s` before the next VIP brings one. Tips reward
active play; the idle economy does not depend on them.
`requests`: now and then (`chance`) a VIP's bubble is a wish instead of a
tip: a department track `levels_ahead` above where it stands. Tapping
accepts it; meeting it within `duration_s` pays `tip_mult` times that VIP's
tip plus `gems`. One request at a time; letting it lapse costs nothing.

types.name: Locals
types.desc: Neighbours who pop in on the way home.

types.name: Little Explorers
types.desc: Small, loud, and certain the dinosaur winked at them.

types.name: Tourists
types.desc: Came for the gift shop, stayed for everything else.

types.name: Collectors
types.desc: Old money with an eye for the rare. Tips generously.

types.name: Art Critics
types.desc: One good review and the whole town comes.

types.name: Celebrities
types.desc: Here for the selfie. The photos go everywhere.

types.name: Royal Patrons
types.desc: A visit by royal appointment. The whole museum stands a little straighter.
